correctness.rationale: The deterministic event equivalence is proved in both directions for all finite chains and world counts; the two cases are disjoint. The minima tie identity, coordinatewise ordering probability, and exact weighted/uniform laws are derived with explicit independence hypotheses. Finite-positive crossover uses weak geometric-minimum limits and summable tails; zero and infinite crossover endpoints are bounded separately. Exact brute-force evaluation with rational probabilities checked 29 small configurations (486,250 valuation pairs) independently against the original modal terms; it is corroboration rather than infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact equality frequency is a natural quantitative invariant refining fundamental validity of modal K. The result determines the complete finite-chain law, its arbitrary iid atom-mass analogue, a nontrivial logistic n/k crossover, sharp fixed-chain exponential bases, and noncommuting limiting operations. The parameter scale and crossover are motivated by minimum-valuation ties in many-world finite-valued semantics, not by an arbitrary finite slice.
